nodes.description: Public owner address of the Owned contract; set to msg.sender in the constructor and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Token symbol string, set to "PUG" in the TokenERC20 constructor.
Token name string, set to "Pug Token" in the TokenERC20 constructor.
Token decimals, set to 18 in the TokenERC20 constructor.
Internal total supply value initialized in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Special 'newun' address guard used by transfer and transferFrom to block transfers to that address.
Mapping of token balances per address; the core accounting state of the token.
Nested mapping of allowances owner=>spender=>amount used by approve/allowance/transferFrom.
Constructor of Owned that sets owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that stores _newOwner into newOwner to start a two-step ownership transfer.
Completes ownership transfer; requires msg.sender == newOwner and clears newOwner.
Constructor of TokenERC20 that initializes metadata, mints the whole supply to owner and emits Transfer.
onlyOwner setter that updates the newun guard address.
View returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using SafeMath.sub.
View returning balances[tokenOwner].
Transfers tokens from msg.sender; requires to != newun and updates balances with SafeMath.sub/add.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval; no return-value checks.
Spends allowance and moves balances; contains a hidden newun side-effect when newun == address(0).
View returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then performs an external call to spender.receiveApproval before returning true; state changing external call (reentrancy surface).
Fallback function on TokenERC20 that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ether.
onlyOwner function that transfers the entire contract balance to msg.sender via address.transfer.
Payable fallback of PugToken that accepts ether and can act as a re-entry point.
msg.sender; the only external untrusted input in this code (no timestamp or tx.origin usage).
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed inside approveAndCall after state was already modified.
address(this).balance transferred to _owner via .transfer inside clearCNDAO; interaction that can invoke the recipient fallback.
Parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership.
Parameter _newun of transfernewun.
Parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf, used to index balances.
Parameter to of transfer, used as the credit address and newun check.
Parameter tokens of transfer, the amount moved.
Parameter spender of approve, used to index allowed[msg.sender].
Parameter tokens of approve, stored as allowance.
Parameter from of transferFrom, debited address and allowance owner.
Parameter to of transferFrom, credited address.
Parameter tokens of transferFrom, the amount moved.
Parameter tokenOwner of allowance.
Parameter spender of allowance.
Parameter spender of approveAndCall; also the untrusted external call target.
Parameter tokens of approveAndCall, stored as allowance and forwarded in the callback.
Parameter data of approveAndCall, forwarded verbatim to the external receiveApproval call.
Local variable _owner = msg.sender in clearCNDAO, the ether transfer recipient.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
Owned constructor writes the owner state variable.
Constructor reads msg.sender to set the initial owner.
transferOwnership writes the newOwner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before executing transferOwnership.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against the owner state variable.
Parameter _newOwner is stored into newOwner.
acceptOwnership assigns owner = newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner.
TokenERC20 constructor sets symbol.
TokenERC20 constructor sets name.
TokenERC20 constructor sets decimals.
TokenERC20 constructor sets _totalSupply.
TokenERC20 constructor mints the supply into balances[owner].
Owner address is used as the mint recipient in balances.
transfernewun writes the newun state variable.
onlyOwner modifier gates transfernewun.
onlyOwner reads owner to authorize transfernewun.
Parameter _newun is assigned to the newun state variable.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)].
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping.
transfer requires to != newun before moving funds.
transfer debits and credits the balances mapping.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender].
Parameter to is the transfer recipient checked against newun.
Parameter tokens is the amount subtracted/added in transfer.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][...].
Parameter spender indexes the allowed mapping in approve.
transferFrom branches on newun == address(0) and otherwise requires to != newun.
transferFrom updates balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender for the allowance.
Parameter from indexes balances and allowed and triggers the newun side-effect.
Parameter to receives the credited balance.
Parameter tokens is the amount moved in transferFrom.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes allowed in allowance.
Parameter spender indexes allowed in allowance.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
approveAndCall uses msg.sender as allowance owner and as the from argument of receiveApproval.
Parameter spender is both allowance target and external call target.
Parameter tokens is stored as allowance and forwarded to receiveApproval.
Parameter data is forwarded into the external call.
approveAndCall makes an external call to an attacker-chosen contract after state updates, enabling reentrancy.
Untrusted spender address is the receiver of the external call.
Untrusted data payload is passed to the external callback.
onlyOwner modifier gates clearCNDAO.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender to owner for clearCNDAO.
clearCNDAO initiates an ether transfer of the full contract balance.
clearCNDAO assigns msg.sender to the local _owner.
Local _owner is the recipient of the ether transfer.
The ether transfer invokes the recipient's payable fallback (PugToken fallback pattern), an external callback that can re-enter.
msg.sender flows into the local _owner variable inside clearCNDAO.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _newOwner is only used to set newOwner inside transferOwnership; it should be inlined into the function node.
Parameter _newun is a direct alias for the newun write inside transfernewun.
Parameter tokenOwner is only an index into balances in balanceOf and can be folded into the function node.
Parameter to exists only inside transfer (newun check and credit address).
Parameter tokens is the local amount moved in transfer; fold into fn_transfer.
Parameter spender is only used to index allowed in approve.
Parameter tokens is only stored as the allowance value in approve.
Parameter from is a local addressing detail of transferFrom.
Parameter to is a local addressing detail of transferFrom.
Parameter tokens is the local amount moved in transferFrom.
Parameter tokenOwner is only an index into allowed in allowance.
Parameter spender is only an index into allowed in allowance.
Parameter spender is the local allowance target and external call target inside approveAndCall.
Parameter tokens is the local allowance amount in approveAndCall.
Parameter data flows directly into the untrusted external receiveApproval call and should be folded into that unsafe operation.
Local _owner is just msg.sender used as the transfer recipient, so it merges into the ether-transfer unsafe operation.
